# #108 — Audit and harden existing provenance/citation primitives

Parent epic: #104

## Goal

Harden source provenance and citation primitives so synthesized answers and evals can verify where memory-derived claims came from.

## Required Behavior

- Every synthesized claim that depends on memory should be traceable to one or more source entries.
- Citation payloads should include stable IDs, table/source type, namespace-safe title/summary fields, and timestamps when available.
- Redaction rules must prevent secret leakage in citations, logs, test fixtures, and PR/issue output.
- Source staleness should be available to synthesis and evals.

## Implementation Notes

- Inspect current table projections and search result shapes before adding fields.
- Keep citation structures narrow and stable; avoid dumping full raw metadata.
- Do not bypass existing read-policy helpers.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Citation/source shape is documented.
- Tests cover citation shape and namespace-safe source exposure.
- `brain_answer` can consume this citation shape without custom ad hoc parsing.

## Validation

- `bun run typecheck`
- targeted tests for search/source/citation behavior
- `bun test`
